headline: Mechanical Engineer | Structural Analysis, FEA, CAE Automation & Scripting, Durability, Reliability & Stress Analysis
summary_html: Mechanical Engineer with 10+ years of experience in structural analysis, solid mechanics, and finite element analysis (FEA) across utility-scale solar, aerospace, and research environments. Hands-on with Abaqus, ANSYS, LS-Dyna, MSC Nastran/Patran, HyperWorks, CATIA V5, MATLAB, Python, and C++, with experience in fatigue, fracture, nonlinear dynamics, material modeling, thermo-mechanical simulation, test correlation, stress analysis, structural integrity, and design optimization.

achievements.text: Performed fatigue, durability, and reliability analysis on PV module structures under wind, transport, snow, and field loading to identify critical failure locations and improve long-term performance.
Built and executed explicit dynamic, implicit nonlinear, and large-deflection FEA models for structural, impact, and packaging applications using ANSYS and LS-Dyna.

Developed and calibrated material models for glass, metals, elastomers, polymers, and viscoelastic components to support fracture and failure analysis using tensile, bending, and structural test data.

Created Python, MATLAB, and JSL automation workflows for pre/post-processing, DOE studies, parameter estimation, and HPC data movement, using Ansys Python modules such as PyDPF and PyVista for result extraction, visualization, and faster simulation turnaround.
Applied structural mechanics across solar, aerospace, and research programs, combining FEA, testing, optimization, and CAD-based engineering.

Performed electromagnetic simulation using ANSYS EMA 3D to model static electric-field distribution in perovskite tandem solar modules and assess field-driven degradation risk across critical layers and edge regions.

skill_sections.title: FEA & Structural Mechanics
skill_sections.content: Structural analysis, stress analysis, structural integrity, linear and non-linear FEA, explicit and implicit dynamics, fatigue analysis, fracture mechanics, modal analysis, frequency response, large-deflection simulation, thermo-mechanical multiphysics

skill_sections.title: Simulation Platforms
skill_sections.content: Abaqus, Abaqus/Standard, Abaqus Explicit, ANSYS Workbench, ANSYS APDL, LS-Dyna, MSC Nastran/Patran, HyperWorks, OptiStruct, HyperCrash, ADAMS

skill_sections.title: CAD, Design & PLM
skill_sections.content: CATIA V5, Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, sheet-metal and surface modeling, assembly detailing, BOM creation, drafting, GD&T, Enovia PLM

skill_sections.title: Testing & Correlation
skill_sections.content: Instron, ARAMIS, tensile testing, four-point bending, structural test correlation, stress distribution assessment, probability of failure evaluation, margin-to-fracture studies

skill_sections.title: Optimization, DOE & Materials
skill_sections.content: Design of experiments, parameter estimation, sensitivity analysis, topology optimization, convex optimization methods, material model calibration, viscoelastic materials, adhesive failure modeling

skill_sections.title: Programming & HPC
skill_sections.content: Python, MATLAB, C++, JSL scripting, CATIA VBA, Tcl/Tk, FORTRAN, Slurm, SSH automation, OpenMP, simulation data pipelines, pre/post-processing automation

experience.title: Development Engineer 3
impact: Performed fatigue analysis of PV modules under wind-induced vibration, using modal and dynamic FEA to identify critical locations and recommend design changes for long-term reliability.

Executed explicit dynamic simulations in LS-Dyna and ANSYS to evaluate module packaging performance under drop, transport, and snow-impact loading, reducing reliance on repeated physical test iterations.
Built non-linear implicit models with large deflection, contact, and convergence complexity to support robust structural and reliability assessments on complex assemblies.
Modeled advanced materials including glass, metals, elastomers, and viscoelastic components, and calibrated simulation behavior using tensile, bending, and fatigue-related test data.
Correlated FEA predictions with physical reliability testing through tensile and four-point bending experiments on Instron systems and structural-level measurements using ARAMIS.
Implemented and calibrated a cohesive zone model to predict Mode I and Mode II failure of polymer adhesive beads using Double Cantilever Beam and End-Notched Flexure test correlation.
Led design and optimization of PV module frames using ANSYS and LS-Dyna to balance reliability, manufacturability, and cost requirements.
Performed coupled thermo-mechanical simulations for P3 laser scribe and Hot-Air-Knife processes to understand process-induced stresses and define viable design and process windows.

Performed electromagnetic simulation using ANSYS EMA 3D to model static electric-field distribution in perovskite tandem solar modules and assess field-driven degradation risk across critical layers and edge regions.
Used MATLAB and JMP with JSL scripting for parameter estimation, sensitivity studies, and DOE model development to calibrate FEA behavior and quantify uncertainty in predictions.
Developed Python automation workflows for ANSYS pre/post-processing, using PyDPF to extract and process simulation results and PyVista to visualize field outputs, improving analysis turnaround time.
Built Python-based data pipelines between engineering workstations and HPC clusters using SSH and Slurm to support large DOE studies with many design points for reliability simulations.
Executed topology optimization studies in ANSYS to identify efficient material distribution and stiffness improvements for structural components supporting weight and cost reduction targets.

experience.title: Design / Stress Engineer
impact: Performed static strength and fatigue analysis on Airbus A350-900XWB wingtip leading-edge components to support structural integrity and airworthiness requirements.
Performed meshing, defeaturing, hand calculations, and detailed stress analysis of airframe components using HyperMesh and MSC Nastran/Patran.
Calculated fatigue life of structural components using Airbus ISAMI tools and flight vibration load data.
Developed design solutions for installation of test equipment and sensors on Boeing 737 MAX flight-test programs.
Created 3D part, sheet-metal, and surface CAD models in CATIA V5, generated assemblies and drawings, created BOMs, and released components through Enovia PLM.
Performed static, modal, and frequency-response analysis of flight-test structures using Abaqus and prepared supporting SCN reports.
Presented design review packages covering installation strategies, structural considerations, and refurbishment plans.
Automated portions of 3D modeling and finite element model generation through CATIA VBA, Tcl/Tk, and Python scripting.

entries.title: Graduate Student Assistant
bullets: Supported research on microstructure instability in ultra-fine-grained aluminum films using in-situ TEM deformation with automated crystal orientation mapping.
Worked with EBSD and OIM datasets to characterize nanocrystalline aluminum film microstructure under deformation.
Built geometry and analysis models from OIM datasets, meshed them using HyperMesh, and ran non-linear implicit simulations in Abaqus/Standard.
Developed Python and MATLAB scripts for FEA pre/post-processing and correlation of simulation results with experimental data.
Built C++ modules using the Abaqus C++ API for result-data transformations and created Abaqus user subroutines in FORTRAN.
Worked with plastic, viscoelastic, hyperelastic, and hypoelastic material models in advanced materials research workflows.

entries.title: Integrated Applications of Nanofluid Heat Transfer to Microelectronic Packages
bullets: Evaluated integrated nanofluid cooling concepts for microelectronic packages and studied thermal-performance improvement opportunities.
Performed nanofluid simulations of integrated micro-fin cooling systems using CATIA V5 and ANSYS Fluent.

entries.title: Dynamic Behavior of Materials Under Shock Loads
bullets: Prepared a technical paper on mathematical modeling of shock loads, impact, crash behavior, and experimental determination of dynamic material parameters.
Performed explicit non-linear impact simulations in Abaqus Explicit to study acoustic impedance and stress-wave behavior.

entries.title: FEA Program for Structural and Dynamic Analysis
bullets: Developed a complete FEA program in C++ to perform stress analysis of 2D and 3D elastic models using 6-node triangle and 8-node elements.
Programmed implicit and explicit structural dynamics solvers in MATLAB using Wilson-theta and two-step methods.

Implemented numerical methods in C++ including finite differences, differentiation, integration, interpolation, and linear/differential equation solving, and created GUI-based numerical solvers with Qt.
Applied OpenMP-based parallel computing in C++ on ASU's Agave cluster to support high-performance analysis workflows.

entries.title: Topology Optimization Algorithm Development
bullets: Developed a program for topology optimization of 2D structures based on the SIMP methodology.
Applied topology optimization to a four-wheeler buggy and a delta parallel robot using OptiStruct.

entries.title: Stress Concentration and Parametric Modeling Using Abaqus and Python
bullets: Performed stress analysis of plates with discontinuities and used Python scripting to automate parametric studies of hole-profile variations in Abaqus/CAE.

entries.title: Design of Composite Wing Box
bullets: Designed a composite airplane wing box using classical laminate theory, stack-up sequence optimization, and FE stress analysis using HyperMesh and OptiStruct.

entries.title: Vehicle Roll Cage NVH and Fatigue Analysis, SAE INDIA BAJA 2013
bullets: Completed 3D modeling of an ATV in CATIA V5, meshed the vehicle using HyperMesh, and performed crash energy management and occupant safety analysis with explicit non-linear FEA in HyperCrash.
Used Simulink and Android-based acceleration-data acquisition for engine vibration analysis.
Performed structural optimization with OptiStruct, fatigue-life analysis with Simulia/fe-safe, and dynamic testing using live road-load acquisition from accelerometers.
